info.title: EURODIS Platform TEST-API - Receive PAN data from EURODIS (before: PAN Import)
info.description:
Other EURODIS Platform APIs:

  • Send PAN data to EURODIS (before: PAN Export)
  • PUDO (Pick-up and Drop-off)
  • Send Tracking data to EURODIS (before: Tracking Export)
  • Receive Tracking data from EURODIS (before: Tracking Import)
  • Send POD (Proof of delivery) to EURODIS
  • Receive POD (Proof of delivery) from EURODIS
  • Get Label from EURODIS
  • Send and receive Pick-up orders
  • Receive Clearing data from EURODIS

Authentication:

Authentication takes place via an API key assigned to the partner.
This must be transferred via the request header as X-API-Key.

Example using the EURODIS Platform TEST-API - PUDO (Pick-up and Drop-off) to receive all parcel stations (remember to replace ******** with your TEST-API key!):

### Returns all parcel stations of the other partners GET https://testapi.eurodis.com/pudo/parcel-stations/v1 X-API-Key: ******** - Hint: If you save the content of the example in a .http or .rest file, you can execute the request with Visual Studio 2022 (provided a valid key has been inserted). Further information can be found here.

edReference.description:
The unique shipment number inside the Eurodis network.
For a detail definition of the Eurodis shipment number please refer to document A02 of the Eurodis network manual.

referencedEurodisShipmentNumber.description: EURODIS shipment number of the original shipment. Mandatory for Type "R", "D" and "A"; conditional for "P"; optional for "E"

shipmentTypeIndicator.description: N = Normal; A = Pickup Orders; P = Result shipment of a pickup order; R = Return shipment; X = AUX-Pan; B = normal shipment in neighbourhood business (NB) setup; D = return shipment in neighbourhood business (NB) setup; E = pickup shipment in neighbourhood business (NB) setup; C = B to C shipment flag (flag “C” can be used on optional basis and must be prior agreed between dispatch partner and delivery partner); Y = B to C shipment in neighbourhood business (NB) set up; L = Return request; M = Return from consignee shipment (only used for transmission to initial delivery partner, transmitted as “R” for transit partner and for delivery partner), as “E” to delivery partner in neighbourhood business (NB) W = shipment distributed without EUROPLATE

lineHaulIndicator.description: Must be "N" (Normal), "D" (Direct Injection) or  "L" (Direct line haul)

clearanceTimestamp.description:
Date time when the shipment PAN-dataset was created
For example "2000-01-31T18:30:00.000Z" for the 31.01.2000 at 18:30

entranceTimestamp.description:
Entrance date of the shipment in partners domestic system; Time when the shipment was physically consigned
For example "2000-01-31T18:30:00.000Z" for the 31.01.2000 at 18:30

numberOfHandlingUnits.description:
Total sum of colli and pallets
The number of handling units must match the number of collis transferred!

shipmentWeight.description: Weight in kilogram with two decimals

truckLicensePlate.description: License plate of the truck (and trailer)

termsOfDeliveryText.description:
Optional for shipments within the EU, mandatory for non-EUcountries:
Must be one the official Incoterms DPU or EXW (for PickUps and Returns) or one of the network-internal Incoterms DDC and DDX

contactName.description:
Contact name at the address, printed on EUROPLATE address 2. line
If PUDO shipment, contains name of shop.

contactTelephone.description: Condition for booking-in service: if booking in service is bil. agreed between partners and booking in flag is provided in DeliveryService

alternativeContactTelephone.description: Alternative contact telephone (alpha to account for international dialling code)

contactSMS.description:
SMS number for primary contact. Format: country prefix (+XX) followed by the phone number.
Example +491711234567

contactEMail.description: EMail address of primary contact, see also Annex A09 - E-Mail Pre-advice Service Matrix

companyName.description: For "toB" shipments name of the company or organisation; for "toC" shipments name of the receiver; printed on EUROPLATE address 1.line

additionalAddressInfo1.description:
To be used to indicate additional address information like department, building name, floor, door code (i.e digicode France), room number, parcel machine number etc.
printed on EUROPLATE address 3.line

additionalAddressInfo2.description:

printed on EUROPLATE address 4.line

streetNumber.description:
Street number printed on EUROPLATE address 5. line
Condition: In case the dispatch partner's IT system supports the separated transmission of the street number.
If the dispatch partner’s IT system does not support a separate transmission for street number, the street number must be provided in the same field as for the street name

countryCode.description: Country code (ISO 3166- 2 alpha country code list checked against platform database); printed on EUROPLATE address 6. line

deliveryService.description: Must be D (Day), T (Timed), M (Morning), A (Afternoon), E (Evening), 6 (Saturday), 7 (Sunday), B (Book in), W (Delivery window), F (Delivery before 10:00) or Z (Pick-up and Drop-off Delivery)

deliveryType.description: Must be S (Signature required), N (Signature not required), D (Secure drop), I (Secure id), B (Consolidation at the drop-off partner is required) or C (Consolidation at the delivery partner (which is not the initiating partner) is required). B and C are only valid in the case of a return via PUDO!

secureDeliveryId.description: Secure drop id or id to be used for secure delivery

deliveryBookInRequired.description: Logical true or false delivery partner is to arrange delivery book in details

deliveryTimeWindowStart.description:
Only to be used on delivery window service. Only to be entered when service is a time specific delivery service such as timed services
Format HH:mm:ss

deliveryTimeWindowEnd.description:
Only to be used on delivery window service
Format HH:mm:ss

deliveryDateWindowStart.description:
Only to be used on delivery window service. Only to be used for date specific delivery service
Format yyyy-MM-dd (For example 2000-01-31 for 31.01.2000)

deliveryDateWindowEnd.description:
Only to be used on delivery window service
Format yyyy-MM-dd (For example 2000-01-31 for 31.01.2000)

completeDeliveryOnly.description: If customer requires delivery of all colli in one delivery set as true otherwise false

additionalNotification.description: Contact details if a third party needs contacting to inform of delivery

paymentReason.description: Actually for COD between Post AT and TOF-DE only 13 digits (EURODIS Shipment Nr) used

paymentReference.description: Actually for COD between Post AT and TOF-DE only 12 digits (EURODIS Shipment Nr) used

amount.description: Amount in given currency with two decimals

currency.description: EUR or other ISO Currency Codes

identifierForCODCollection.description:
COD with cash collection or check collection;
Cash collection is standard for Post AT and most partners
Must be 3 (Cash) or 5 (Check)

commercialValueOfGoods.description: For insurance reasons; mandatory if not documents

currency.description: The currency code if commercial value is filled (EUR or other ISO Currency Codes)

dutyCode.description: For non EU mandatory (=customs tariff number)

descriptionOfGoods.description: Optional information about the transporting trucks for e.g. Switzerland

billOfDanger.description: Hazardous label; Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 5. Entering in format N or N.N. Example 3 = 3; 6.1 = 6.1

additionalBillOfDanger1.description: Additional bill of danger 1 Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 5, values in brackets. Entering in format N or N.N. Example 3 = 3; 6.1 = 6.1

additionalBillOfDanger2.description: Additional bill of danger 2 Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 5, values in brackets. Entering in format N or N.N. Example 3 = 3; 6.1 = 6.1

additionalBillOfDanger3.description: Additional bill of danger 3 Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 5, values in brackets. Entering in format N or N.N. Example 3 = 3; 6.1 = 6.1

tunnelLimitationCode.description: Values B, B/D, B/E, C, C/D, C/E, D, D/E or E are possible

packingGroup.description:
Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 4. Values of 1 – 3 are possible.
Please use Arabic notation.

adrGrossWeight.description: Declaration of the ADR-gross weight in kg or volume in l for the described material according to ADR chapter 1.1.3.6

unNumber.description: Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 1; If LQ, filled with default value

transportCategory.description: Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2., table A, column 15. Values 0 – 4 are possible.

materialDescription.description: Proper shipping name; Specification in ADR manual, chapter 3.2, appendix A, column 2; If LQ, filled with default value

technicalName.description:
Material, which is subject to special provision 274 in ADR Manual chapter 3.2, appendix A column 6, must be marked with the additional technical name.
Example: MaterialDescription would be: "UN 1993 FLAMMABLE LIQUID, N.O.S.", then TechnicalName should be: "(CONTAINS XYLENE AND BENZENE)"

identifierMassOrVolume.description: Here the identifier for mass or volume of ADR-goods has to be transmitted as “kg” or “l”, for LQ goods the entry must be "kg"

smsPreAdvice.description: If true, ContactSMS in ConsigneeAddress must be filled

eMailPreAdvice.description: If true, ContactEMail in ConsigneeAddress must be filled

telephonePreAdvice.description: If true, ContactTelephone in ConsigneeAddress must be filled

europlateBarcode.description:
EURODIS collo barcode
default value (0) in case of neighbourhood business

referencedEuroplateBarcode.description: Filled only if the unit is part of a return shipment, referencing the original EURODIS collo barcode

consignorsColloBarcode.description:
Original delivery partner’s domestic return barcode generated/ allocated by EURODIS return solution, Customer or Despatch partner Barcode ID.
For neighbourhood business the domestic barcode of the respective partner must be provide in accordance to SOP – Neighbourhood business.

deliveryPartnerBarcode.description:
Delivery partner barcode from the central label service (CLS)
Only filled, when the delivery partner is using this service.

dispatchPartnerBarcode.description:
Dispatch partner barcode from the central label service (CLS)
Only filled, when the dispatch partner is using this service.

pudoOpeningCode.description: Barcode, pin or other information to open the drop off point in respective country.

explanationOfParcelType.description:
